name: inline-edit
title: Inline Edit
description: A title you edit in place: the input has the same type and padding as the title so nothing moves when it opens. Enter or leaving saves with a spinner and then a check that pops in, Esc rewinds, an empty title shakes, an unchanged one closes quietly
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/inline-edit · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/inline-edit.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: inline edit, editable title, rename in place, click to edit
